evidence: DWARF of main.c declares LARGE_INTEGER (play local `li`) and calls LoadLibraryA, QueryPerformanceCounter, QueryPerformanceFrequency, ShellExecuteA and WSAStartup; the original call sites use the stdcall symbols (_LoadLibraryA@4). Allegro's documented way to reach the Win32 API is <winalleg.h> after <allegro.h>, which provides these declarations, WSADATA and MAKEWORD/LOBYTE/HIBYTE. The hand-written stdcall prototypes and the WSADATA/MAKEWORD copies in main.c are substitutes for that header; LoadLibraryA was implicitly declared and relied on the linker's stdcall fixup.
